races.verdict: The form of LA VALSERINE 's French bumper worked out extremely well and, having joined the all-conquering Mullins yard, she's taken to land what looks a warm mares maiden on hurdling debut. races.display_title: Race And Stay Irish EBF Beginners Chase
races.verdict: A most interesting beginners chase with the narrow vote in favour of CLASSICAL CREEK . Absent since finishing down the field in Grade 1 company over hurdles at Naas in January, his profile prior to that was a most positive one and firmly appealing as the type to make an even better chaser, he can enhance his yard's solid recent record in this race. Fruit de Mer and Kopeck de Mee are others making plenty of appeal, with Forty Coats rounding off the shortlist. CLASSICAL CREEK FRUIT DE MER (IRE) KOPECK DE MEE (FR)

races.verdict: Prolific in handicap hurdles last season, MASK OF ZORRO picked up where he left off when making a successful transition to chasing at Newton Abbot (3¼m) 18 days ago. Totally unexposed at marathon trips and hailing from a stable who continue in rude health, this dual course winner looks a major player again. Jeu d'Opale tackles a much longer trip on return but appeals as being on a good mark, with last year's winner Livin On Luco and hat-trick seeker Paper Mill also shortlisted. MASK OF ZORRO (IRE) JEU D'OPALE (FR) LIVIN ON LUCO (IRE)
